title: Sales Director (North America)
description:
Reporting directly to the SVP of Sales, you will be the driving force behind our revenue growth and market expansion in North America. Because this is a key territory operating across a time difference from our European headquarters, you will need to be a highly motivated self-starter with the autonomy and drive to build and lead a successful sales organization independently. You will scale and inspire a high-performing team of sales professionals to evangelize our end-to-end solar development platform, playing a critical role in taking our ARR to the next level.

• Strategic Leadership: Develop and execute comprehensive strategic sales plans to achieve and exceed regional revenue targets across the North American solar and data center markets.

• Team Building & Scaling: Hire, manage, and mentor a high-performing B2B sales team from the ground up, fostering a culture of quality and accountability in a remote environment.

• Executive Alignment: Create, communicate, and accurately forecast sales goals, ensuring C-level executives and global HQ are consistently informed on progress, pipeline health, and market penetration.

• Relationship Management: Build and maintain long-lasting, strong relationships with key enterprise customers (Utility-scale developers, EPCs, hyperscalers, and data center developers). Partner with them to deeply understand their business objectives and position PVcase as a strategic solution.

• Business Development: Plan and oversee all regional initiatives to rapidly expand our customer base. Promote the company’s software platform by addressing clients’ complex pain points regarding solar design, power availability, and data center site selection.

• Sales Cycle Mastery: Deliver, manage, and continuously improve the full sales cycle across the North American team.

• Market Intelligence: Conduct market research to identify new segments and customer needs within the co-development space. Stay abreast of competing markets, providing actionable reports on market movement, competitor positioning, and competitive intelligence.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Share knowledge with other regional branches, Customer Success, and the Product team to leverage effective practices and highlight emerging business opportunities.

• Industry Presence: Attend and represent PVcase at major conferences, tradeshows, and industry events related to both the solar market and data center/hyperscale infrastructure to expand our network and partnership opportunities.

Requirements

• Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in B2B sales and/or business development, ideally within a high-growth SaaS business ($50M-$100M ARR range).

• Leadership Track Record: At least 3 years in a leadership role (such as Director of Sales, Head of Sales, or similar), with a proven track record of hiring, building, and managing successful sales teams from the ground up.

• Performance: Demonstrated history of increasing company performance, consistently exceeding quotas, and driving overall business leadership that results in greater profitability and market positioning.

• Technical Acumen: Familiarity SaaS Tech Stack / CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) is a strong advantage.

• Skillset: Commercial acumen combined with analytical rigor. Excellent planning, organizational, leadership, negotiation, and verbal/written communication skills.

• Hands-on Approach: Ability to take strong leadership in team and strategy development while remaining a hands-on teammate willing to roll up their sleeves.

• Culture Fit: Strong work ethic with high energy and a willingness to learn on the job. Must be sociable, curious, creative, and passionate-aligning perfectly with PVcase ’s core values.

• Industry Knowledge: Ideal candidates will have proven experience selling software or services into the solar industry, data center siting/development, or the intersection of both.

title: Engineering Manager - Observability | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs . We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote position. We are considering candidates in Germany, Sweden, Spain, Ireland and the UK only.
The opportunity:
Grafana Cloud is our composable observability platform that integrates metrics, logs, traces, and profiles with Grafana. It allows our customers to leverage the best open source observability software - including Prometheus, Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope - without the overhead of installing, maintaining and scaling their own observability stack.
The Observability department is focused on enabling developers to understand the health and performance of their applications and infrastructure in any environment by providing tools to instrument their code, ingest observability data into Grafana Cloud and visualize and explore it.
What is the Ingest team?
We build and maintain the configuration and deployment tooling that bridges the gap between "I want observability" and "I have observability,". To achieve this the team owns Fleet Management, the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart, and the Instrumentation Hub. Fleet Management is the cloud-based central control plane our customers use to manage hundreds of thousands of Observability Collectors in the wild. The Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart is used to effectively deploy Observability Collection in Kubernetes based environments. The Instrumentation Hub seamlessly combines Fleet Management and the Kubernetes Monitoring Helm Chart to achieve a magic 1-command instrumentation experience.
What You'll Be Doing:

• Manage and develop the team of backend and frontend engineers, providing regular feedback and supporting each person’s growth through career conversations. This is a remote team, distributed between EMEA and NASA.

• Collaborate closely with go-to-market to ensure customers and prospects are successful with their Observability collection journey.

• Work closely with product and engineering leadership to ensure Fleet Management, the Kubernetes Helm Chart, and the Instrumentation Hub fit seamlessly into the end-to-end user experience for Grafana cloud products.

• Provide guidance throughout the project lifecycle from early ideation through planning, execution and post‑launch guiding the team to deliver high‑quality results consistently.

• Foster a psychologically safe environment where engineers can learn, experiment and iterate quickly, encouraging innovation and a culture of continuous improvement.

• Work across team boundaries by contributing to projects outside your team’s scope and partnering with other functions to solve customer problems.

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Sr. Revenue Cycle Billing Specialist (Remote, Remote, US)
description:
Role Description

The Revenue Cycle Denials Representative is responsible for managing and resolving denied Professional Billing (PB/CMS-1500) and/or Hospital Billing (HB/UB-04) claims. This role identifies root causes of denials, executes appeals and corrective actions, and collaborates with internal teams to prevent future denials. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with CARC/RARC denial codes, Epic denial work queues, and payer-specific appeal requirements across Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers.
Roles & Responsibilities

Denial Review & Resolution - PB & HB

• Review and analyze denied PB (CMS-1500 / 837P) and HB (UB-04 / 837I) claims to determine root causes and appropriate resolution strategies.

• Analyze account history and all previous actions in Epic prior to taking the next action step to resolve the claim.

• Work claims across all top denial categories including, but not limited to: No Authorization, Timely Filing, Coordination of Benefits (COB), Medical Necessity, Additional Documentation Requests (ADR), Bundling (NCCI edits), and Duplicate Claims.

• Interpret CARC and RARC codes on 835 ERA / EOB remittance data for both PB and HB claims to determine the correct resolution path.

• Understand when claim corrections, rebilling (837P or 837I), or void-and-replace actions are appropriate.

• Escalate claims with payers for resolution when processing is inaccurate or delayed.

Appeals & Reconsiderations

• Prepare and submit appeals and reconsideration requests in compliance with payer-specific guidelines and deadlines for both PB and HB denied claims.

• Attach appropriate clinical documentation, medical records, authorization references, and justification letters to support appeal submissions.

• Meet appeal deadlines for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers in accordance with payer-specific requirements.

Trend Identification & Prevention

• Identify denial trends across PB and HB claim types and collaborate with coding, clinical, and billing teams to implement corrective actions.

• Monitor payer policy and regulatory changes (Medicare LCDs/NCDs, Arkansas Medicaid updates) to proactively prevent denials.

• Assist in developing best practices and training materials for PB and HB denial management and prevention.

Payer & System Knowledge

• Navigate Epic denial and underpayment work queues for both HB and PB modules; document all denial actions and resolutions.

• Utilize payer portals (Availity, Arkansas DHS, Medicare.gov, and commercial payer sites) to research denial reasons and submit appeals.

• Utilize resources provided by the client to promote accuracy and resolve claims in accordance with client expectations.

Compliance & Documentation

• Maintain thorough documentation of denial reasons, appeal actions, and resolutions in Epic.

• Ensure compliance with federal, state, and payer regulations as well as hospital and physician practice policies.

• Communicate effectively with insurance representatives and internal leaders to expedite resolution and improve processes.

• Always maintain confidentiality of patient and account information (HIPAA).

• Adhere to prescribed policies and procedures outlined in the Employee Handbook and Code of Conduct.

• Maintain awareness of and actively participate in the Corporate Compliance Program.

• Maintain a confidential and orderly remote work area.

• Meet specified goals and objectives assigned by management and/or the Client.

• Assist with other projects as assigned by management.

Expected / Key Results

• Deliver high levels of client and patient satisfaction (CSAT)

• Achieve quality scores per defined process standards

• Deliver defined process-specific metrics (e.g., denial resolution rate, overturn rate, appeal success rate)

• Adherence to regulatory compliance requirements

• Schedule adherence

Preferred Educational Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent required

• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Health Informat

Wayve is building a new generation of autonomous driving technology powered by end-to-end AI. Our Robotaxi Engineering team is responsible for turning that intelligence into a complete Level 4 autonomous driving system that can operate safely and reliably in the real world.

This is one of Wayve’s most important engineering leadership roles. As VP, Engineering, Robotaxi, you will lead the engineering organisation responsible for taking our Robotaxi product from development through deployment and scale.

The challenge is inherently multidisciplinary. Delivering a Robotaxi requires bringing together AI, onboard software, vehicle systems, sensors and compute, safety, validation, simulation and fleet operations into one coherent system.

You will lead across those boundaries, setting the technical direction and building the organisation required to deliver a safe, scalable L4 product.

title: Mathematics Subject Matter Expertise
description:

Mathematics Subject Matter Expert, India Remote, India, Freelance, project-based.

A typical brief might be a set of exam-style questions for a Year 11 topic with full worked solutions, or a booklet section aligned to the VCE syllabus, delivered to a clear spec and an agreed deadline.
About Contour We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture. Freelance does not mean lower standards here. Your worked solution is still the moment a stuck student gets it or does not, so clarity is still the whole job.

You take clear briefs from the content team and produce questions, worked solutions, booklet sections, and assessments for Grades 9 to 12, aligned to the VCE and Pre-VCE syllabus. The quality bar is the same as our in-house team: accurate, logically structured, with step-by-step solutions written in a tutor's voice that a student can follow on their own. To be clear, this is content creation, you build resources from a brief, rather than answering one-off student questions. You work remotely on your own schedule, to deadlines agreed per project. This is freelance and project-based, paid per project or per resource, agreed openly upfront. • Take briefs and build. Produce original maths content to a clear spec: questions, worked solutions, booklet sections, and assessments.

• Write like a tutor. Deliver step-by-step, student-friendly solutions that explain the reasoning, not just the answer.

• Align to the syllabus. Match the VCE and Pre-VCE curricula for accuracy, consistency, and fit.

• Deliver to deadline. Manage your own schedule and hand work in on time, to spec.

• Revise cleanly. Take feedback and turn it around without losing quality.

Requirements

What You Need

• Strong mathematics, comfortable across Grades 9 to 12, VCE ideally.

• A proven ability to write clear content and worked solutions, with a sample or portfolio to show it.

• Excellent written English and sharp attention to detail.

• Reliability to deadlines, and the self-management that freelance work needs.

• Cross-timezone comfort, with some overlap into Australian time for briefs and feedback.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with VCE mathematics or another international curriculum.

• Prior edtech content, academic writing, or tutoring experience.

• A portfolio of maths resources or worked solutions you have created.

title: Security Engineer L3
description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced L3 Security Engineer to lead security engineering, architecture, and continuous improvement across multiple customer environments within a Managed Service Provider (MSP).

This senior technical role goes beyond security monitoring and alert triage. You will design and implement security controls, lead vulnerability remediation, strengthen compliance, resolve complex security incidents, and establish consistent security standards across customer environments.

Working closely with infrastructure teams, service desk engineers, Account Managers, and customers, you will take ownership of security outcomes while mentoring junior engineers and driving a proactive approach to cybersecurity.

About the Client

You will be working with a technology and managed services provider supporting multiple customer environments. The organisation is focused on strengthening cybersecurity, improving service delivery, and developing scalable security standards that help customers reduce risk and maintain resilient IT environments.

Ideal Profile

Technical Expertise

• Significant experience within an MSP, MSSP, or IT Service Provider environment

• Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender and its security ecosystem

• Advanced experience with Sophos Firewall and endpoint security technologies

• Proven experience managing vulnerability and patch management programs

• Experience implementing security controls across Microsoft 365 environments

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Zero Trust security principles

• Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing, firewalls, VPNs, and network segmentation

• Strong Windows Server and endpoint troubleshooting capabilities

• Experience handling complex technical escalations and leading remediation activities

• Ability to design and implement practical security improvements rather than simply identify risks

Security Platforms & Technologies

• Hands-on experience with ConnectSecure and Huntress is highly desirable

• Experience with Sophos ZTNA, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Defender XDR, and Conditional Access is advantageous

• Familiarity with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Office 365, Identity, and Vulnerability Management

• Knowledge of Essential Eight, CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and ISO 27001

• PowerShell scripting and API-based automation experience is beneficial

• Familiarity with MSP PSA platforms such as HaloPSA, ConnectWise, or Autotask

• Relevant Microsoft, Sophos, or cybersecurity certifications are advantageous

Security Architecture & Compliance

• Experience assessing security architectures and identifying technical weaknesses

• Ability to translate compliance requirements into practical security controls

• Strong understanding of cybersecurity threats, attack techniques, and defensive measures

• Experience developing remediation strategies, security baselines, and technical standards

• Ability to prioritise vulnerabilities based on exploitability, exposure, asset criticality, and business impact

Leadership & Communication

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Excellent technical documentation and reporting capabilities

• Ability to lead complex remediation activities and provide technical direction

• Confidence making technical decisions and challenging inadequate security practices

• Strong problem-solving skills and a methodical approach to incident investigation

• Ability to remain calm during critical incidents while considering customer priorities and operational impact

• A proactive mindset focused on root causes, automation, standardisation, and preventing recurring issues

Responsibilities

Security Architecture & Technical Leadership

• Act as a senior technical authority for security across multiple customer environments

• Design, review, and improve customer security architectures

• Establish security standards

- Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

- Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks https://langfuse.com/blog/2025-10-29-launch-week-4 so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

We’re Valatam , a team that connects bilingual professionals from Latin America with global clients. Our people are our pride, and we’re thrilled to be certified as a Great Place to Work for the 2025-2026 period, proof that great work starts with great people.
About the Role
We are looking for an Accounting Associate to provide reliable accounting and financial support to international clients in a fully remote environment.
This role is ideal for an organized, analytical, and detail-oriented bilingual professional with 3-5 years of experience in accounting, finance, or a related role. • Experience preparing or supporting financial reporting and financial analysis.

• Experience working with payroll, tax-related information, budgeting, or audit documentation.

description:
ABOUT BEACON AI

We’re a fast-moving team of aviators, engineers, and operators building an AI platform to make flying safer, more efficient, and more capable. Backed by top investors, we’ve secured a dozen Department of Defense contracts and partnered with major airlines to deliver mission-critical systems. We operate without silos or heavy processes. Small, focused teams own what they build, ship quickly, and learn fast, pushing the boundaries of how humans and AI work together in aviation.

ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking a Staff Frontend Software Engineer to bring technical leadership, strong ownership, and strategic thinking to our frontend team. In this role, you will drive the development of high-impact web interfaces that integrate with our flight safety platform, enabling users to interact with complex aviation data and derive actionable insights. You will collaborate closely across disciplines and play a key role in advancing aviation safety and operational capability.

What You’ll Do

- Design and implement React-based features while architecting frontend systems that handle large-scale, real-time and historical aviation data.

- Integrate, process, and visualize data from multiple sources, including live streams and archived datasets.

- Mentor engineers and drive best practices through code reviews and architectural discussions.

- Partner with backend engineers, product managers, and UX/UI designers to make informed design and implementation decisions.

- Ensure reliable, maintainable frontend systems through automated testing, clear documentation, and strong engineering standards.

- Build reusable components and internal libraries to accelerate future development.

What Will Make You Successful

- 9+ years of experience building and shipping high-performance, user-facing web applications.

- Deep expertise in React, TypeScript, JavaScript, state management, and modern web standards (HTML/CSS).

- Strong experience with asynchronous frontend patterns and efficient handling of live and historical data streams.

- Proven ownership of complex features or product areas, driving work from concept through delivery with a high degree of autonomy.

- Proactive, resourceful mindset with the ability to operate effectively in fast-moving, ambiguous environments.

- Consistently sets and upholds a high technical bar through design decisions, code quality, mentorship, and hiring input.

- Ability to analyze and optimize frontend performance for scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.

Bonus Points

- Passion for aviation and a desire to improve air travel efficiency and safety.

- Experience with geospatial or mapping tools such as Mapbox or Cesium.

- Deep experience with live data streaming and playback systems.

- Experience with video streaming technologies and real-time media delivery.

Work Location
This is a hybrid role based in San Carlos, CA, with 3+ days per week onsite and the option to work remotely on remaining days.

Perks & Benefits (Full-Time Employees)

- Healthcare: 100%* of employee medical premiums covered; 25% for dependents

- Time Off: 3 weeks PTO plus 13+ paid company holidays

- 401(k): Offered (no current employer match, but we are committed to enhancing this benefit in the future)

Due to U.S. export control regulations, we can only hire U.S. Persons (U.S. citizens, Green Card holders, lawful permanent residents, or individuals granted asylum or refugee status). We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers. All work must be performed in the United States.

Beacon AI is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. We prohibit harassment or discrimination of any kind in the workplace and comply with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws.

title: Marketing Director
description:

Lead the accounts

• Own day-to-day delivery across your accounts: scope, timelines, deliverables, and reporting.

• Serve as the main point of contact for client leads and their teams, running kickoffs, status meetings, and quarterly and annual reviews.

• Track milestones so campaigns, creative, reports, and other deliverables go out on time and on spec.

• Own client performance evaluations (on federal contracts these are formal ratings called CPARS), including monthly reports, self-assessments, and responses.

• Keep account documentation and SOPs organized in Asana, SharePoint, and Teams.

Guide the work

• Turn client goals into strategic communications and marketing plans.

• Oversee digital, social, creative, research, and outreach campaigns.

• Review and approve creative, social content, briefs, and editorial products before they reach the client.

• Use performance data and KPIs to optimize campaigns and shape strategy.

Lead the team and grow the accounts

• Manage account staff and project managers, and coordinate creative, digital, subcontractor, and partner teams.

• Manage account budgets, staff hours, burn rates, and other direct costs; review invoices and timesheets.

• Spot opportunities to expand scope and propose new solutions; support pricing and estimates for new work and renewals.

• Contribute to new business proposals, including writing, team resumes, and case studies.

What you bring

• 8+ years in account management, client services, or program management at a marketing, PR, advertising, or communications agency, or a comparable in-house role.

title: Supervisor, Environmental Health and Safety
description:
About Us

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting & Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally. 

 

About the Company

Fanatics Collectibles is a new company operating at the intersection of collectibles, culture, and technology. Backed by world-class investors, operators, and sports & entertainment partners, we are building the global leader in next-generation collectibles. As part of the broader Fanatics ecosystem, we leverage a digital sports platform that spans over 900 sports properties and engages more than 81 million fans. Together, we are reimagining every part of the collectibles experience for fans, partners, and creators.

 

Role Summary

The Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the implementation, compliance, and continuous improvement of environmental, health, and safety programs within the organization. This role requires a proactive approach to identify potential hazards, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote a culture of safety among employees.

 

Key Responsibilities:

• Program Development and Management:

• Develop, implement, and maintain EHS policies, procedures, and programs in accordance with local, state, and federal regulations.

• Ensure effective communication of EHS policies to all employees.

• Regulatory Compliance:

• Monitor and ensure compliance with environmental and safety regulations, standards, and best practices.

• Conduct regular audits and inspections to identify compliance gaps and ensure corrective actions are taken.

• Training and Awareness:

• Design and deliver EHS training programs for employees at all levels, ensuring understanding and compliance with safety protocols.

• Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns and engagement initiatives.

• Incident Management:

• Investigate workplace accidents, incidents, and near misses; prepare reports and recommend corrective actions.

• Maintain records of incidents and ensure proper documentation and reporting to regulatory bodies.

• Risk Assessment:

• Conduct risk assessments and safety inspections to identify potential hazards and recommend mitigation strategies.

• Work with management to prioritize safety improvements and allocate resources effectively.

• Emergency Preparedness:

• Develop and implement emergency response plans and drills to prepare employees for potential emergency situations.

• Coordinate with local emergency services and ensure compliance with emergency response regulations.

• Data Analysis and Reporting:

• Analyze safety data and trends to provide insights and recommendations for continuous improvement.

• Prepare and present EHS reports to management, highlighting key metrics and areas for improvement.

• Collaboration and Communication:

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to promote a safe and healthy work environment.

title: Senior Platform Product Manager (m/f/d)
description:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters - keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

Requirements

- Act as the bridge between technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment on platform priorities, trade-offs, and delivery timelines

- Evaluate and shape integration strategies for emerging technologies, including AI/ML services, MCP protocols, and data pipeline architectures

Responsabilities

- 7+ years of experience in the tech industry with a strong understanding of product and engineering workflows, team dynamics, and modern software development practices

- At least 2 years of recent, hands-on experience in a heavily technical product domain such as platform engineering, data infrastructure, AI/ML, or API development

- Proven background in platform or technical product management; experience in data platforms or data engineering is a strong plus

- You actively integrate AI into your daily workflows and are continuously refining and expanding how you use AI-powered tools to increase your effectiveness

- Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between deeply technical concepts and strategic business language

- Strong analytical mindset with a structured approach to prioritization, problem-solving, and stakeholder alignment

- You thrive in cross-functional environments and are comfortable navigating ambiguity, legacy systems, and evolving technical landscapes

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Hybrid work and flex-time
